title: 10万美元怎么投？彭博专家三大策略
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Tech investors are officially getting rattled. A massive June sell-off wiped 600 billion off the market value of SpaceX, soon after its mega IPO, and semiconductor stocks have been plunging
segments.zh: 科技市场参与者开始感到不安。六月的大规模抛售在SpaceX巨额IPO后抹去了其6000亿美元市值，半导体权益资产也因对AI涨势可持续性的疑虑而暴跌。

segments.en: over doubts about the sustainability of the AI rally. In such a jittery market, if you have a six-figure windfall to invest, where should you actually put it? While tech grabs the headlines,
segments.zh: 在如此动荡的市场中，如果你有一笔六位数的意外之财要**，应该投向哪里？科技股占据头条，但积极消息正在其他地方悄然积累。

segments.en: positive news is quietly building elsewhere. An interim peace agreement between the US and Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz, driving oil prices down and easing inflation. Plus,
segments.zh: 美伊临时和平协议可能重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，压低油价并缓解通胀。此外，企业盈利和就业数据好于预期。

segments.en: corporate earnings and job numbers are holding up better than expected. Bloomberg asked top wealth experts how to invest $100,000 in this environment. Tech and AI showed up in some of their
segments.zh: 彭博询问顶级财富专家如何在这种环境下**10万美元。科技和AI出现在一些建议中，但主要聚焦于三种策略：杠铃策略、优质价值选股和动量交易。

segments.en: ideas, but the main focus was on three specific strategies, the Barbell approach. Balancing exchange traded funds focused on large cap US growth companies, with stocks in Japan, in Greece, as well as in
segments.zh: 杠铃策略：平衡聚焦美国大盘成长股的ETF与日本、希腊权益资产，以及黄金、石油等实物资产。

segments.en: real assets like gold and oil. Quality value picking. Focusing on high profitability,
segments.zh: 优质价值选股：聚焦高盈利、合理定价的权益资产，如Visa、万事达卡和礼来。

segments.en: reasonably priced stocks like Visa, Mastercard, and Eli Lilly, the momentum play, riding the wave into potential breakout sectors like industrials, materials, and regional banks.
segments.zh: 动量交易：顺势进入潜在突破板块，如工业、材料和地区银行。
